TestBootstrapConsistency::test_consisten.description: 2-node cluster (rack1/rack2), RF=2, hinted handoff off. Writes keys 10-19 at CL=ALL, stops node1, writes keys 30-999 at CL=ONE (only node2 has them), restarts node1 without repair, bootstraps node3 into rack2, then reads every key from node3 at CL=ALL. Guards consistent range movement on bootstrap (CASSANDRA-2434): the new node must stream from the replica that gives up ownership (node2, full data), not from the stale node1, otherwise CL=ALL reads lose data. In scylla it exercises vnode bootstrap streaming/RBNO (consistent-topology job) and tablet migration on bootstrap (tablets job).
